definitions.explanation: A message delivered orally through another person, rather than in writing. Used when asking someone to relay a message to a third party.

examples.japanese: {伝言|でんごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦できますか→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{伝言|でんごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えて→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pass the message to him.

examples.japanese: {伝言|でんごん}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: The story changed in the game of telephone.
examples.notes: 伝言ゲーム = telephone game (party game)

notes:
USAGE: {伝言|でんごん} refers to spoken messages relayed through an intermediary. It's commonly used in phone conversations and business settings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {伝言|でんごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to ask someone to relay a message)
- {伝言|でんごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ (to leave a message)
- {伝言|でんごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧ (to pass on a message)
- {伝言|でんごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧ (may I leave a message?)

RELATED WORDS:
- {伝言|でんごん}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧ (telephone game - party game)
- ⟦{伝言板|でんごんばん}→伝言板：16788_dengonban⟧ (message board)
- {伝言|でんごん}⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧ (message memo)
- ⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧ (message - loanword)
- ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧ (contact, communication)

PHONE USAGE: When calling and the person isn't available, you can say 「{伝言|でんごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦できますか→できる：00557_dekiru⟧」 to leave a message.
